attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Vibranium Spear Thrust
steps: |!wild| |*Pierce|: Change one of the defending character's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a blank.
|!wild| |*Flurry|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a Strike attack.

superPowers.name: Bodyguard
superPowers.body: When another allied character within |!range| 2 of this character is targeted by an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of range and LOS.

superPowers.name: General of the Dora Milaje
superPowers.body: This character may reroll one die in its defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack targeting it from within |!range| 2, this character adds blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
